text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm out for a walk on my day off when I
spot a downcast Mayano Top
Gun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, it's Maya! Hey, Maya! We were
talking about going shopping
after this.
Wanna join us?
text_block_list.name: Maya's Friend A

text_block_list.text:
Hrm... Sorry, but I think I'm gonna pass this
time. I have to head out
now.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Head out? Where?
text_block_list.name: Maya's Friend B

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go see some airplanes!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh... hi.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list:
You seem to be out of spirits. What's the
matter?

text_block_list.text: Hrmmmm...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Let's talk about something else. Are you
free?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Or... busy, maybe?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It looks like Mayano wants me to stay, so I
decide to accompany her
for the day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Touchdown! Ehehe, we're finally here! ♪
It's a bit far from the
academy, but I like
this place a lot.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at that! That plane has a special
wrap! Wooow! They even
have a Beluga
here!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yep! You see that white plane? The one
that looks like it has a giant
head? It's
named Beluga after the whale! It looks like
that 'cause it
has to carry other planes
inside of it!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You don't get to see them often, so we're
super lucky today! ♪ Oh
right, I should
take a picture while I'm here...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Three... two... one... Cheese! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Nice, this one turned out great! ☆
Heh-heh... Looks as cute as ever...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I mean, c'mon. The sky is full of all sorts of exciting things! And planes go zoooom right through it!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: So of course I like planes! Who wouldn't?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Actually, my dad really likes planes too!
He likes them so much that
he became a
pilot!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
So on his days off, he'd bring me to the
airport like this and show me
the different
planes! And then we'd go shopping after
we were done
looking!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh... It's nothing! No big deal.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Enough about that. I'm starving! Let's go
grab a bite to eat or
something! There's a
lot of good food at airports!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And after we're done eating, we can walk
around some more!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
First, we'll go shopping! I wanna buy some
stuff for my friends.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I need to buy something for Marvey and
Teio... Oh, and for Yukipe,
Biko, and
Flower too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: You sure do have a lot of friends, Mayano.

text_block_list.text: Ehehe, right?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hold up, we can't waste our time just
standing around like this! C'mon,
let's go!
Hurry!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
This day will go down as "The Greatest
Airport Adventure in Maya's
Life"! It's time
for takeoff!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
After eating together, we have fun walking
around the airport from
store to store,
checking out everything it has to offer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Eventually...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wait, it's already this late?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It'll take some time to get back to the
academy. We gotta get back
before
curfew, so I guess we should head out...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I try thinking of ways to cheer her up,
when suddenly, the Beluga she
told me
about earlier pops into my field of vision.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As it makes its way towards the runway for
takeoff, I come up with an
idea.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Hey, Mayano. How about we stop by the
observation deck?

text_block_list.text: Huh? But why? ...Oh, wait!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
The Beluga's taking off! Whoa, I wanna see
it fly!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: If we get back late, I'll go apologize with you.

text_block_list.text: You will?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Okay, to the observation deck we go!
Takeoff!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Whoooa! Wooow! Did you see that?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: It was all like boooom, and then it went like peeeew. "Beluga" really is the perfect name for it... It's like a whale that swims through the sky!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Looking at Mayano staring off into the sky
from the observation deck,
I can see that
she's back to her usual cheery self.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Nice! We made it juuust in time!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yep! A fun end to a fun day! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I reeeeally had a lot of fun today! Like, so,
so, so much fun!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Mom and Dad aren't here at the academy.
It's totally fine, but...
sometimes I think
about how I'm here by myself, and it
makes me feel
kinda... lonely, I guess.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But I have soooo many friends, and now I
have you too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Let's go on another adventure
together sometime, okay?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган furiously waves her hand
then makes her way back
to her dorm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
